welcomeTitle.translation: Bari mu shirya maka don ziyararka.

welcomeSubtitle.translation: Ka amsa wasu tambayoyi game da bayyanar cututtukanka.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Wannan ya haɗa ziyararka da bayananka.

btnSendToDoctor.translation: Yana da kyau aika zuwa likita

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Idan alamunku suna da tsanani ko kuma suna kara muni a yanzu, kada ku jira kira sabis na gaggawa.

urgencySeekCare.translation: Da fatan za a nemi kulawa a cikin sa'o'i 1 zuwa 2

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Alamomin ka na nuna wani abu da ya kamata a gani nan ba da jimawa ba.

urgencyNextSteps.translation: Mene ne zai faru a gaba?

urgencyStep1Title.translation: An aiko muku da takardunku a yanzu.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Ƙungiyar likitanci za ta karɓi tarihinku nan da nan.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Idan hakan ya yi muni, ka ɗauki mataki da sauri

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Rashin tsanani ko gaggawa kira sabis na gaggawa nan da nan.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Wannan ƙididdigar gaggawa ce ta atomatik, ba ganewar asali ba.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: An riga an gan ka a asibitin nan.

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Sun riga sun riƙe bayananka, don haka ƙungiyar kulawarka ta ga cikakken tarihinka nan da nan.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?
findSearchTitle.translation: A ina za ka so a gan ka?

findScanning.translation: Binciken asibitocin Triavi kusa da ku...

findHospitalsNear.translation: {count} asibitocin da ke kusa da ku

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.
findErrLocation.translation: Ba za mu iya samun wurinka ba.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Za mu sanar da kai a lokacin da likitan ya buɗe shi.

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Idan ya fi muni, ka yi aiki yanzu.

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Idan bayyanar cututtukanka sun yi tsanani ko kuma sun yi muni ba zato ba tsammani kira sabis na gaggawa yanzu ko je sashen gaggawa mafi kusa.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Mun sanya alamar shari'ar ku a matsayin fifiko mafi girma don haka ƙungiyar kulawa ta sani.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Wani likitan asibiti yana duba takardunku. Za mu sanar da ku yayin da yake ci gaba.

stepUrgency.translation: Wajibi ne a yi hakan da gaggawa

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Ka amsa wasu tambayoyi game da yadda ka kasance tun lokacin da ka ziyarci.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Ta yaya yanayinka ya bambanta da na dā?

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: An aika da amsoshinku ga ƙungiyar kula, kuma likitan zai bincika su kuma ya tuntube ku idan ya cancanta.

checkinResultEscalate.translation: Don Allah ka nemi taimako yanzu

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Alamominku sun nuna cewa akwai wani abu da ke bukatar a kula da shi nan da nan. Kada ku jira ku tuntuɓi ƙungiyar kula da ku ko ku je sashen gaggawa mafi kusa.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Ba za a iya samun wannan bayanan ba. Shiga ciki don ganin rajistarku na yanzu.

claimBody.translation: Ka ƙirƙiri asusun kyauta don bin wannan ziyarar kuma ka tsallake lambar a karo na gaba.

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Abin da muke karewa, da abin da kuke sarrafawa.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Za a cire sunanka, bayanan tuntuɓarka, da kuma amsoshinka kafin wani abu ya bar asibitinka.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Ka bar bayanan da ba a gano su ba su inganta kulawar kowa. Za ka iya canja wannan a kowane lokaci.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Za ka iya canja wannan a kowane lokaci.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Asusunka da bayanan tuntuɓarka na dindindin za a cire su kuma asibitin zai adana tarihin kulawarka kamar yadda doka ta bukaci.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Ka nemi takardar shaidar ziyararka, magani, da kuma tarihin kiran da ka yi.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Wannan yana kawar da asusunka da bayanan tuntuɓarka har abada. Asibitinka yana riƙe da tarihin kulawarka kamar yadda doka ta bukaci. Ba za a iya soke wannan ba.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Ƙungiyar kulawarku za ta tabbatar da ku ta imel a cikin sa'o'i 72.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Zaɓi tsari kuma ka nemi fitarwa. Za mu shirya shi kuma mu aika maka da amintacciyar hanyar haɗi zuwa adireshin imel ɗin da ka yi rajista.

downloadSheetFormatPdf.translation: PDF (yana zuwa nan ba da daɗewa ba)

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Za mu aika maka da imel a cikin sa'o'i 24.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Ba a sauke fayil a nan ba - ana aika bayananka cikin aminci zuwa adireshin imel ɗin da ka yi rajista.
